old_drug_scope: current 720 project registry; historical approval date not asserted
label_aggregation: raw measurements filtered by period BEFORE grouping and thresholding; positive mean pChEMBL >=6, negative mean <=5 or explicit inactive; conflicts/grey excluded separately in each window
new_relation_definition: no earlier qualifying measurement, including grey and negative; any undated qualifying measurement excludes pair from first-seen claim
dense_candidate_risk_set: 720x384 minus all qualifying records known by cutoff and undated records; no unknowns added as inactive biochemical training labels
base_selection: mean measured validation drug/target AP on 2021-2022 first-seen pairs
adapter: fixed J topology: frozen two-seed V3 + bounded directional residual + signed evidence + frozen BerMol/ESM2 interaction
retrieval_training_labels: dated experimental positives on project old drugs within training cutoff; undated project MoA additions are NOT used
adapter_selection: 0.35*(dense old-drug d2t AP+t2d AP)+0.15*(d2t R20+t2d R20), measured AP each direction >= base minus 0.01, epoch0 eligible
refit: fresh random initialization on <=2022 data; selected development epochs fixed; all schedules keep original max-epoch denominator
pretraining_scope: current frozen public unsupervised representations; not an as-of-2022 pretrained-resource simulation
claim: retrospective temporal label/support isolation; published year proxy, not prospective validation
